materialist-tendencies.title: Materialist Tendencies in Arab-Islamic Philosophy
materialist-tendencies.arabicTitle: النزعات المادية في الفلسفة العربية - الإسلامية
materialist-tendencies.author: Husayn Muruwwa
materialist-tendencies.lead: A sweeping alternative history of Arab-Islamic philosophy, from pre-Islamic Arabia through Ibn Sīnā, organised around a Marxist reading of social history, intellectual conflict and the development of philosophical thought. All four volumes are freely available in modern English alongside the Arabic text.

volumes.title: Pre-Islamic Arabia — The Rise and Early Period of Islam
volumes.blurb: Method, pre-Islamic society, the rise of Islam, and the era of the Rightly Guided Caliphs.

volumes.title: The Muʿtazila — Ashʿarism — Logic
volumes.blurb: The roots of philosophical thought: Shiʿa, Kharijites, Muʿtazila, Ashʿarism, and formal logic.

volumes.title: The Development of Philosophy — Sufism — The Brethren of Purity
volumes.blurb: Sufism, the Brethren of Purity, the natural sciences, and the maturing philosophical tradition.

volumes.title: al-Kindī — al-Fārābī — Ibn Sīnā
volumes.blurb: The mature philosophical stage through al-Kindī, al-Fārābī, and Ibn Sīnā.

within-iranian-islam.title: Within Iranian Islam
within-iranian-islam.subtitle: Spiritual and Philosophical Aspects
within-iranian-islam.author: Henry Corbin
within-iranian-islam.lead: Henry Corbin’s masterwork on the spiritual and philosophical life of Iran after Islam: Twelver Shiism and its hermeneutics, Sohrawardî’s philosophy of light, Rûzbehân and the Sufism of the “faithful of love”, the School of Isfahan, the Shaykhi School and the Twelfth Imam. The four volumes have never had a complete English translation; here they are in modern English, with the complete French original alongside.

volumes.title: Twelver Shiism
volumes.blurb: Shiism and Iran, the Twelve Imams, the sacred book and its inner meanings, prophecy and walâyat, and what the Imam means for Shiite spiritual life.

volumes.title: Sohrawardî and the Platonists of Persia
volumes.original: Sohrawardî et les Platoniciens de Perse
volumes.blurb: Sohrawardî’s “Eastern” theosophy of light: the Zoroastrian Light of Glory, the archangelic hierarchies, the Grail, and the tales of the Crimson Archangel and the Western Exile.

volumes.title: The Faithful of Love · Shiism and Sufism
volumes.original: Les Fidèles d’amour · Shî’isme et soufisme
volumes.blurb: Rûzbehân Baqlî of Shiraz and the Sufism of the faithful of love; then Haydar Âmolî, Semnânî and others on where Shiism and Sufism meet.

volumes.title: The School of Isfahan · The Shaykhi School · The Twelfth Imam
volumes.original: L’École d’Ispahan · L’École shaykhie · Le Douzième Imâm
volumes.blurb: Mîr Dâmâd, Mollâ Sadrâ and Qâzî Sa’îd Qommî; Shaykh Ahmad Ahsâ’î and his successors; the Twelfth Imam and spiritual chivalry.

four-journeys.title: The Four Journeys of the Intellect
four-journeys.subtitle: The Transcendent Wisdom of the Four Intellectual Journeys

originalTitle.text: الحكمة المتعالية في الأسفار العقلية الأربعة

four-journeys.author: Mulla Sadra
four-journeys.zip: The Four Journeys - Complete Bilingual Markdown.zip
four-journeys.lead: Mulla Sadra’s great philosophical work, The Transcendent Wisdom in the Four Intellectual Journeys, traces the path from the questions of existence and causation to the nature of God, the world, the soul and the afterlife. Read all nine volumes in English or switch to the original Arabic at any point. Every volume has its own table of contents and endnotes; the complete bilingual Markdown is available to download.

volumes.title: General Questions: Existence and Essence
volumes.blurb: The first journey begins with existence: its meaning, reality, necessity, possibility, and the way things come to be.

volumes.title: Essence, Unity, and Causation
volumes.blurb: The inquiry continues through essence, unity, multiplicity, causes, and the relations between things.

volumes.title: Potentiality, Change, Time, and Intellect
volumes.blurb: Potential and actual being, change and motion, time and eternity, and intellect and what it understands.

volumes.title: Natural Philosophy: Quantity and Quality
volumes.blurb: A study of natural philosophy: quantity, quality, relation, and the categories through which things are described.

volumes.title: Natural Philosophy: Substances and Accidents
volumes.blurb: Bodies, matter and form, the kinds of physical things, and the principles of natural change.

volumes.title: Knowledge of God
volumes.blurb: The third journey begins: arguments about the Necessary Being, oneness, divine attributes, knowledge, and power.

volumes.title: Divine Speech, Providence, and Creation
volumes.blurb: The inquiry into divine speech, providence, mercy, creation, and the lasting generosity of the first principle.

volumes.title: The Soul and the Afterlife
volumes.blurb: The fourth journey begins with the soul: its powers, perception, and its relation to the body and intellect.

volumes.title: The Soul and the Afterlife
volumes.blurb: The final volume examines the soul after death, spiritual happiness, resurrection, and the world to come.
